assets.stamina_icon: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for SISYPHUS 2D side-view Greek myth mountain game. One isolated UI icon on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Square canvas. A single roundish broken dark warm grey stone medallion with a bold ivory limestone engraved pictogram, strong high contrast, readable at 64 pixels. Semi-realistic painterly natural stone texture, restrained rough rock details, soft upper-left light. Icon fills central 85% with transparent margins. Absolutely no words, letters, digits, captions, frames or sheet layout. Symbol: a single clearly readable running human silhouette in profile, striding right, with a short blue stamina arc inset along the left rim.
